config.instructions:
Validate the purchase order below.

Run every skill you carry, then return a single structured result that matches the
required output schema. Do not modify the order; propose adjustments only.

```json
@{coalesce(first(outputs('Read_edited_order')?['body/value'])?['faf001_valuejson'], '')}
```

currency.description: Currency code; empty string when unknown or unsupported.

original_merchandise_subtotal.description: Two-decimal amount; empty string when incomplete or unassessable.

discount_total.description: Two-decimal amount; empty string when incomplete or unassessable.

adjusted_merchandise_subtotal.description: Two-decimal amount; empty string when incomplete or unassessable.

proposed_order_total.description: Two-decimal final payable including confirmed tax and shipping; otherwise empty string.

promotion_id.description: Applied promotion ID; empty string when no offer applies.
